zipCodeComparison.neighborhoodsIncluded: Wayne Township Central, North, South, and Hill sections
keyFindings: Homeowners fund 74.5% of the total property tax levy in Wayne Township.
Average annual property tax check is $13,245.36, representing 9.6% of median household income.
Public school district receives 58.4% of every property tax dollar paid by residents.

keyTakeaways.title: Why Schools Take 58.4% of Every Tax Check in Wayne Township
keyTakeaways.detail: Because Wayne Township is classified as an affluent suburban district under NJ SFRA school aid formulas, State Aid covers roughly 10% of educational spending. Local property taxpayers must fund the remaining ~90%.

keyTakeaways.title: Commercial Ratable Retention vs. PILOT Burdens
keyTakeaways.detail: Commercial ratables represent 25.5% of Wayne Township's tax base. Protecting business ratables while ensuring that new luxury developments pay their fair share to the school district is the central taxpayer challenge.
